The placeholders are filled in by a small string-replacement helper, `interpolateUrl`, which the config loader, `navigate`, and the UI components all call. `openmrsSpaBase` comes from `window.getOpenmrsSpaBase()` with the trailing slash trimmed, and `openmrsBase` comes from `window.openmrsBase`.

**How it works**

- `interpolateUrl` (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-navigation/src/navigation/interpolate-string.ts`, lines 37–48) builds the values map: `openmrsBase`, `openmrsSpaBase`, plus any caller-supplied params. It then calls `interpolateString`. It also collapses a leading `//` that the substitution can create, unless the original template started with `//`.
- `interpolateString` (same file, lines 66–69) does a literal split-and-join for each `${key}` in the params. It is not a regex, and placeholders with no matching key are left as-is.
- `navigate` (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-navigation/src/navigation/navigate.ts`, lines 50–64) interpolates `to` before anything else, then strips the origin. It sends same-SPA targets through `navigateToUrl` and everything else through `window.location.assign`.
- Config URLs are fetched through `interpolateUrl` in `createConfigLoader` (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/shell/esm-app-shell/src/run.ts`, lines 257–274).
- Config validation accepts only `openmrsBase`, `openmrsSpaBase`, and any extra names a schema allows. `isUrlWithTemplateParameters` (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-config/src/validators/validators.ts`, lines 23–47) enforces this.
- In tests, `getOpenmrsSpaBase` is stubbed to return `/openmrs/spa/`. For example, `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-navigation/src/setup-tests.js`, line 5.

**Documentation**

- `openmrs-contrib-o3-docs/content/en-US/docs/configure-o3/overview.mdx`, around line 369, says `configUrls` placeholders are interpolated at runtime via `interpolateUrl()`.
- `openmrs-contrib-o3-docs/content/en-US/docs/configure-o3/configure-branding.mdx`, around line 212, covers `${openmrsBase}` and `${openmrsSpaBase}` in branding image paths.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/openmrs/README.md`, line 213, says `configUrls` placeholders are filled in with the SPA path.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-framework/docs/functions/interpolateUrl.md` and `navigate.md` are generated API docs for the two functions.

I used 7 of the 10 search calls and 3 of the 20 read calls. Two grep calls failed because the short repo names weren't accepted, so I retried with the full `github.com/openmrs/...` form. I did not open the definition of `window.getOpenmrsSpaBase` in production code. Only test and mock setups were found, so the real definition is not cited below.
